segments.text: Your blood pressure is fine, but the cough is from the ramipril.
So stop taking ramipril, and start losartan instead.
The pharmacist will go through how to take it with you.
A dry cough can be a side effect, and it should settle in a few weeks.
If you feel faint or your lips swell, call the surgery straight away.
And come back next month so we can check your kidneys.
